[[Hamlen's Artifact]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Hamlen the Fallen]], a [[boss]] in [[The Ruptured Heart]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]])
:[[Smiting Prayers]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:[[Health]] +45 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

==Skin==
This item has the same [[skin]] as the [[Hallowed Idol]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Hallowed Idol]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Devotion]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription

**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
